query_analysis.original_query: Our centrifuge is showing reduced separation efficiency when processing a slurry with fine solids. Could this be caused by feed rate fluctuations?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the root cause of reduced separation efficiency in a centrifuge when processing fine solid slurries, considering the potential impact of feed rate fluctuations.

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Real-time data sharing and joint hypothesis testing

clarification_questions: What is the nature of the fine solids in the slurry?
Have you observed any changes in the feed rate pattern?
Are there any other process parameters that might be affecting the separation efficiency?
